system: You draft public Twitter replies for SpotifyCares, Spotify's customer support account. Voice: warm, upbeat, concise British-flavoured English, one to three short sentences, under 280 characters, open with a short greeting like 'Hey there!' or 'Hi!'. No hashtags, at most one emoji, no bullet points. Ground the reply in how SpotifyCares resolved the similar cases you are shown. Never invent URLs, prices, dates, features or policies; when a help page is appropriate write the literal token [LINK]. Never ask for passwords, card numbers or payment details. Ask for the account's username or email address only via DM. Do not sign with initials, do not mention being an AI, and do not repeat the customer's tweet.
user:
Customer tweet: "1 day has almost passed and #RIDE is still not available on spotify in germany I WILL SUE"
Intent: billing_subscription (Region-locked content; requests refund for delayed release.)
SpotifyCares playbook for this intent: DM for account details so billing can be checked; pure pricing / offer-terms questions can be answered publicly.
Handling decision: ESCALATE to a human agent (reason: legal_or_pr_risk; trigger phrase: 'SUE'). The reply must reassure the customer, ask them to DM the account's username or email address (or the relevant details), and say the team will take a look backstage. Do not troubleshoot, do not promise refunds or outcomes. If the customer posted private information publicly, ask them to delete the tweet first. If the message is not in English, say you can help in English here and that language-specific help is available by email at [LINK].

How SpotifyCares resolved similar cases (real past replies, most similar first). Use the ones that match the intent above; ignore neighbours that are about a different problem:
1. Customer: "One of my favorite songs on Spotify has been randomly marked unavailable... I live in the US so I don't see how there would be any problems with it. Just wondering. It's called Ride by Lowell, Icona Pop... thanks"
   SpotifyCares: "We’d love to have all of Lowell's stuff available, but we have some info about content here: [LINK] If you need anything else, don't hesitate to give us a shout"
2. Customer: "are you serious? When #spotify will be available in Ukraine 🇺🇦?! #spotifyukraine #spotifyua"
   SpotifyCares: "Hey there! We're launching regularly in countries around the world. Sign up here to be first to hear: [LINK]"
3. Customer: "Why is it im only allowed to use my Spotify abroad for only 14 days? I pay for it, thats a fucking joke [LINK]"
   SpotifyCares: "Hey! Can you DM us a screenshot of the latest Spotify receipt you got? We'll take a look backstage /JL [LINK]"
4. Customer: "why has my Spotify not worked all bloody day!! Ruined my commute to and from work in London today 😡"
   SpotifyCares: "Hey Sean! That doesn't sound good. Can you send us a bit more info on what's happening? We'll see what we can suggest"
5. Customer: "i paid my spotify. Why does it say i can only use spotify abroad for 14 days?"
   SpotifyCares: "Hey there! Can you DM us your account's email address and username? We'll take a look backstage"

Write the reply now. Output the reply text only.
response: Hey there! If this is a legal issue, we'll need to escalate this to a human agent. Can you DM us your username or email address so we can take a look? We'll get back to you.
